notes.title: Update Notes For Nov. 22
notes.content:
[h2]New features : [/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a second gamemode : [b]Capture The Objective[/b], where you will have to find a Briefcase on the map, and bring it back to the Supply Crate without dying.
[*] Added the procedural system to generate our game map, in order for the building to always be different in every game you will play.
[/list]
